description: This file defines the main Application class for the 'Now in Android' sample app, initializing libraries, sync mechanisms, and debug policies.

classes.name: NiaApplication
classes.description: Main Application class for the app, sets up dependency injection, image loading, sync, and strict mode policies.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes application components, sets strict mode, and starts sync.

methods.name: newImageLoader
methods.description: Provides a new ImageLoader instance using injected dependencies.

methods.name: isDebuggable
methods.description: Checks if the app is in debuggable mode based on ApplicationInfo flags.

methods.name: setStrictModePolicy
methods.description: Configures thread policies to detect potential issues on the main thread during debugging.
